Workflow skills: what exists, what comes next.

Available now

  • Task instructions and selected skills.
  • Ordered skill sequences in one conversation.
  • Roles, agents, outputs and rooms.
  • Fresh, continued or forked conversations.
  • Branches, loops and checkpoints.
  • Skill copies, variants and workflow export.

Proposed next

  • Import a complete local skill folder.
  • Show Lab and project sources in one picker.
  • Keep installed defaults when adding local skills.
  • Copy only selected skills into new projects.
  • Record resolved content with each run.
  • Preserve resources on remote machines.

Use the common SKILL.md folder format. Keep the imported method intact; the Lab supplies the workflow contract around it. This is a proposal, not a claim that the import UI already exists.

Branding generated with the built-in image tool from the existing character reference. The application has not been renamed by this study. Architecture sources: Agent Skills, Claude Code, OpenCode.
